title: Multi-hazard risk assessment of the Marmara basin: figure-generation and analysis code
description: Documented Python pipeline for a geospatial multi-hazard (earthquake, tsunami, strong wind) risk assessment of the Marmara Sea basin and Istanbul. Generates the publication figures from open geospatial datasets (Copernicus, GEBCO, ERA5, OpenStreetMap, MTA, TUIK, USGS, AFAD).
